Class ContentPack

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Content
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a content pack that can load, cache, index, and provide access to various types of content files. Supports both binary and text-based packs, with options for memory or indexed unpacking.

Remarks

This class only supports content packs created with the ShapeEngine ResourcePacker tool, available in the ShapeEngine GitHub repository.

Methods

Clear()

Clears the content pack by unloading all cached and indexed files. Resets the cache size and unpack mode to None. Returns true if the content pack was loaded and is now cleared; otherwise, false.

public bool Clear()

Returns

bool

Remarks

Call this method to unload the content pack and free memory when it is no longer necessary. Indexed mode uses significantly less memory than memory mode, but file access is slower.

CreateCache(bool, List<string>?, string, int)

Unpacks the content pack into memory, optionally using parallel processing. Skips files with extensions listed in extensionExceptions. For text packs, allows batch size control via textFileUnpackingBatchSize. Returns true if cache creation succeeds and files are loaded.

public bool CreateCache(bool parallelProcessing = false, List<string>? extensionExceptions = null, string directoryRestriction = "", int textFileUnpackingBatchSize = 16)

Parameters

parallelProcessing bool

If true, uses parallel processing for unpacking.

extensionExceptions List<string>

List of file extensions to skip during unpacking.

directoryRestriction string

If set, only files whose relative path starts with this directory restriction will be unpacked. Example: setting to Audio/Music/Background will only load resources within that directory path.

textFileUnpackingBatchSize int

Batch size for parallel text file unpacking.

Returns

bool

True if cache was created and files loaded; otherwise, false.

Remarks

Returns false if the content pack is already loaded or if the source file does not exist. Use IsLoaded to check load status. Use Clear() to unload and clear the cache/index.

CreateCacheAsync(bool, List<string>?, string, int, CancellationToken)

Asynchronously unpacks the content pack into memory, optionally using parallel processing. Use OnAsyncCacheLoaded event to get notified when loading is complete. Alternatively, await this method (see Example).

public Task<bool> CreateCacheAsync(bool parallelProcessing = false, List<string>? extensionExceptions = null, string directoryRestriction = "", int textFileUnpackingBatchSize = 16, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

Parameters

parallelProcessing bool

If true, uses parallel processing for unpacking.

extensionExceptions List<string>

List of file extensions to skip during unpacking.

directoryRestriction string

If set, only files whose relative path starts with this directory restriction will be unpacked. Example: setting to Audio/Music/Background will only load resources within that directory path.

textFileUnpackingBatchSize int

Batch size for parallel text file unpacking.

cancellationToken CancellationToken

Token to cancel the async operation.

Returns

Task<bool>

True if cache was created and files loaded; otherwise, false.

Examples

How to use CreateCacheAsync():

public async Task LoadAndUseContentPackAsync()
{
    var pack = new ContentPack("Resources/Pack.bin");
    bool loaded = await pack.CreateCacheAsync();

    if (loaded)
    {
        // Notify: ContentPack is ready
        // Now use pack normally
        var data = pack.GetFileData("Textures/Logo.png");
        // ... use data
    }
    else
    {
        // Notify: loading failed
    }
}

Remarks

Returns false if the content pack is already loaded or if the source file does not exist. Use IsLoaded to check load status. Use Clear() to unload and clear the cache/index.

CreateIndex()

Creates an index for the content pack, allowing on-demand access to files without loading them into memory. Returns true if the index was successfully created; otherwise, false. Returns false if the content pack is already loaded or the source file does not exist. Use IsLoaded to check load status. Use Clear() to unload and clear the cache/index.

public bool CreateIndex()

Returns

bool

GetFileData(string)

Retrieves the file data for the specified file path from the content pack. Returns null if the content pack is not loaded or the file does not exist.

public byte[]? GetFileData(string filePath)

Parameters

filePath string

The relative path of the file within the content pack.

Returns

byte[]

The file data as a byte array, or null if not found.

Remarks

For example, if the following directory structure was packed:

  • Resources/
  • Resources/Textures/...
  • Resources/Sounds/...
  • Resources/Music/
  • Resources/Music/myBackgroundMusic.mp3
  • Resources/...

The relative filePath stored in the pack to access myBackgroundMusic.mp3 would be Music/myBackgroundMusic.mp3.

UnpackFileToMemory(string, out long, List<string>?, string, bool)

Unpacks a binary content pack file into memory. Reads all files from the specified sourceFilePath, decompresses them, and stores them in a dictionary. Skips files with extensions listed in extensionExceptions. If debug is true, logs detailed unpacking information. Returns a dictionary mapping relative file paths to their decompressed byte data.

public static Dictionary<string, byte[]> UnpackFileToMemory(string sourceFilePath, out long totalBytesUnpacked, List<string>? extensionExceptions = null, string directoryRestriction = "", bool debug = false)

Parameters

sourceFilePath string

The path to the packed binary file.

totalBytesUnpacked long

Outputs the total number of bytes unpacked.

extensionExceptions List<string>

Optional list of file extensions to skip during unpacking.

directoryRestriction string

If set, only files whose relative path starts with this directory restriction will be unpacked. Example: setting to Audio/Music/Background will only load resources within that directory path.

debug bool

If true, enables debug logging.

Returns

Dictionary<string, byte[]>

A dictionary of relative file paths and their corresponding decompressed byte arrays.

UnpackFileToMemoryAsync(string, Action<long>?, List<string>?, string, bool)

Asynchronously unpacks a binary content pack file into memory.

public static Task<Dictionary<string, byte[]>> UnpackFileToMemoryAsync(string sourceFilePath, Action<long>? setTotalBytesUnpacked = null, List<string>? extensionExceptions = null, string directoryRestriction = "", bool debug = false)

Parameters

sourceFilePath string

The path to the packed binary file.

setTotalBytesUnpacked Action<long>

Optional callback to set the total number of bytes unpacked.

extensionExceptions List<string>

Optional list of file extensions to skip during unpacking.

directoryRestriction string

If set, only files whose relative path starts with this directory restriction will be unpacked.

debug bool

If true, enables debug logging.

Returns

Task<Dictionary<string, byte[]>>

A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains a dictionary of relative file paths and their corresponding decompressed byte arrays.

Examples

public async Task LoadContentPackAsync()
{
    string packPath = "Resources/Pack.bin";
    Dictionary string, byte[] files = await ContentPack.UnpackFileToMemoryAsync(packPath);

    foreach (var kvp in files)
    {
        string filePath = kvp.Key;
        byte[] data = kvp.Value;
        // Use filePath and data as needed
        Console.WriteLine($"Loaded {filePath} ({data.Length} bytes)");
    }
}

UnpackTextToMemory(string, out long, List<string>?, string, bool)

Unpacks a packed text file into memory. Each file is stored as two lines: the relative path and the base64-encoded compressed data. Skips files with extensions listed in extensionExceptions. If debug is true, logs detailed unpacking information. Returns a dictionary mapping relative file paths to their decompressed byte data.

public static Dictionary<string, byte[]> UnpackTextToMemory(string sourceFilePath, out long totalBytesUnpacked, List<string>? extensionExceptions = null, string directoryRestriction = "", bool debug = false)

totalBytesUnpacked long

debug bool

If true, enables debug logging.

Returns

Dictionary<string, byte[]>

A dictionary of relative file paths and their corresponding decompressed byte arrays.

public async Task LoadContentPackAsync()

    {
        string filePath = kvp.Key;
        byte[] data = kvp.Value;
        // Use filePath and data as needed
        Console.WriteLine($"Loaded {filePath} ({data.Length} bytes)");
    }
}

UnpackTextToMemoryParallel(string, out long, List<string>?, string, int, bool)

Unpacks a packed text file into memory using parallel processing and batching. Each file is stored as two lines: the relative path and the base64-encoded compressed data. Skips files with extensions listed in extensionExceptions. If debug is true, logs detailed unpacking information. Returns a dictionary mapping relative file paths to their decompressed byte data.

public static Dictionary<string, byte[]> UnpackTextToMemoryParallel(string sourceFilePath, out long totalBytesUnpacked, List<string>? extensionExceptions = null, string directoryRestriction = "", int batchSize = 16, bool debug = false)

Parameters

sourceFilePath string

The path to the packed text file (.txt).

totalBytesUnpacked long

Outputs the total number of bytes unpacked.

extensionExceptions List<string>

Optional list of file extensions to skip during unpacking.

directoryRestriction string

If set, only files whose relative path starts with this directory restriction will be unpacked. Example: setting to Audio/Music/Background will only load resources within that directory path.

batchSize int

Batch size for parallel text file unpacking.

debug bool

If true, enables debug logging.

Returns

Dictionary<string, byte[]>

A dictionary of relative file paths and their corresponding decompressed byte arrays.

UnpackTextToMemoryParallelAsync(string, Action<long>?, List<string>?, string, int, bool)

Asynchronously unpacks a packed text file (.txt) into memory using parallel processing and batching. Each file is stored as two lines: the relative path and the base64-encoded compressed data.

public static Task<Dictionary<string, byte[]>> UnpackTextToMemoryParallelAsync(string sourceFilePath, Action<long>? setTotalBytesUnpacked = null, List<string>? extensionExceptions = null, string directoryRestriction = "", int batchSize = 16, bool debug = false)

Parameters

sourceFilePath string

The path to the packed text file (.txt).

setTotalBytesUnpacked Action<long>

Optional callback to set the total number of bytes unpacked.

extensionExceptions List<string>

Optional list of file extensions to skip during unpacking.

directoryRestriction string

If set, only files whose relative path starts with this directory restriction will be unpacked. Example: setting to Audio/Music/Background will only load resources within that directory path.

batchSize int

Batch size for parallel text file unpacking.

debug bool

If true, enables debug logging.

Returns

Task<Dictionary<string, byte[]>>

A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains a dictionary of relative file paths and their corresponding decompressed byte arrays.

Examples

public async Task LoadContentPackAsync()
{
    string packPath = "Resources/Pack.bin";
    Dictionary string, byte[] files = await ContentPack.UnpackTextToMemoryParallelAsync(packPath);

    foreach (var kvp in files)
    {
        string filePath = kvp.Key;
        byte[] data = kvp.Value;
        // Use filePath and data as needed
        Console.WriteLine($"Loaded {filePath} ({data.Length} bytes)");
    }
}

Events

OnAsyncCacheLoaded

Event triggered when the asynchronous cache loading operation completes. Subscribers can use this to perform actions after the content pack has finished loading its cache.
